$comment: The frozen chrome (redesign-plan.md, step 2): sha256 of each shared region (head, top, colophon, script) as stamped on the frozen pages, with the per-page parameters taken out (see the freeze in test/chrome.test.js). Change these only in a commit that changes the chrome on purpose, and say why there.
frozenAt: Step 2: the home page and Life Strategy Matrix on the new design
changes: Step 5, script: the copy-email part binds every [data-copy-email] button, not only the first, each reporting in the status line beside it, so the Consulting pages' own Ask for a first conversation button and the colophon's both work. The colophon's consulting line is a site.json switch and is taken out before fingerprinting, like the home colophon's own lines.
Step 6, head: the new site icon. Beside favicon.svg the head now links a 32px PNG for browsers that take no SVG icon and apple-touch-icon.png for iOS, all drawn from favicon.svg by generate-icons.js.

Release 1, top: the menu sheet gains a quieter fifth row, 05 Consulting, to consulting.html (marked on the Consulting pages), so a phone reaches the department without scrolling past the whole issue; the masthead still names 01 to 04. The Résumé pills carry aria-current on the résumé itself (taken out before fingerprinting, like every aria-current). The colophon's consulting line now stays off the pages that carry 05 Consulting themselves; it was already taken out before fingerprinting.
After Release 1, head: the icon links carry ?v= (VERSION in generate-icons.js) because Safari kept showing the old cobalt mark it had cached under the same favicon.svg address.

After Release 1, colophon: the Elsewhere list's “Résumé, PDF” link points at Ben-Siverly-Resume-Proptech.pdf, the new public résumé (site.json), in place of the Payments PDF, which stays at ?version=payments.
